protocol.status: strict 50-touch budget: train + validation share 50 rows, everything else raw
protocol.accounting: a row is either paid (gold + model outputs) or raw text; no probes outside the 50; embeddings and router scores on raw rows are free

arms.t25_v25knn: train 25 random + validation 25 acquired sequentially by 5-NN disagreement propagation on raw-text embeddings, seeded by the train rows' free agree/disagree bits
arms.t50_trainval: train 50 random; train rows reused as validation for epoch/threshold selection (no separate validation)
